sources.title: Car rental startup Turo lays off 15% of workforce after halting IPO plans amid market uncertainty - Tech Startups
sources.description: Turo, the San Francisco-based peer-to-peer car rental startup often described as the “Airbnb for cars,” has laid off around 150 employees, roughly 15% of its team, after shelving plans to go public.
